title: MongoBench: Do LLMs Know What a MongoDB Query Will Do?
abstract: arXiv:2611.09065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate databases on their own: they generate queries and run them against live data. Two checks are commonly used to judge such an agent - whether it produces a valid query, and whether it reaches the right final answer - but neither tells us whether the agent knows what its query will actually do before it runs. We argue that this consequence prediction ability must be evaluated in its own right, and we build MongoBench to measure it: given a collection of documents and a MongoDB find() filter, a model must return the exact set of matching _ids, with ground truth from a real mongod server. translated_title: MongoBench：大语言模型知道 MongoDB 查询会产生什么结果吗？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地自主操作数据库：它们生成查询并对真实数据执行。目前评判这类智能体通常采用两项检查——是否生成了有效的查询，以及是否得出了正确的最终答案——但这两者都无法告诉我们，智能体在执行查询之前是否知道该查询实际会产生什么效果。我们认为这种后果预测能力必须被独立评估，为此构建了 MongoBench 来衡量它：给定一个文档集合和一个 MongoDB find() 过滤器，模型必须返回精确匹配的 _id 集合，其真实答案来自真实的 mongod 服务器。这300道题目每道均组合了三到四个有文档记录的匹配陷阱，并由三家厂商的模型对称地提出，因此结果可按题目来源进行分层分析。对四个模型——三家厂商的前沿系统和一个开放权重推理模型——的评估显示，准确率介于 70.1% 至 92.1% 之间，相差达22个百分点。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 MongoBench 基准，通过要求模型精确预测 MongoDB find() 查询匹配的 _id 集合（以真实 mongod 服务器结果为标准答案），首次独立评估了大语言模型在执行查询前预测查询后果的能力，并发现四个模型的准确率相差高达22个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MongoBench, a benchmark that independently evaluates LLMs' ability to predict query consequences before execution—requiring the exact set of matching _ids verified against a real mongod server—revealing a 22-point accuracy spread (70.1%–92.1%) across four models.
